root.label: Type Deduction & CTAD
root.note: Explains how auto, decltype, structured bindings, and CTAD infer types without spelling them explicitly.

children.label: Auto Deduction
children.note: Applies function-template argument deduction rules to variable and return placeholders.

children.label: By-Value auto
children.note: Strips references and top-level cv-qualifiers and decays arrays or functions to pointers.

children.label: const auto& & auto*
children.note: Preserves pointee constness and stops array-to-pointer decay.

children.label: Forwarding auto&&
children.note: Collapses to lvalue reference for lvalues and rvalue reference for rvalues.

children.label: Braced Initializer Rule
children.note: Special auto deduction divergence from standard template argument deduction.

children.label: Copy-List auto = {...}
children.note: Copy-list syntax deduces std::initializer_list<T> when elements share a type.

children.label: auto x{val} (C++17)
children.note: Direct-list syntax deduces single element type T and rejects multi-element lists.

children.label: Decltype Rules
children.note: Inspects declared entity types or expression value categories without evaluating operands.

children.label: Unparenthesized Id-Expression
children.note: decltype(x) and decltype(obj.m) yield the exact declared type of that entity.

children.label: Parenthesized & Value Category
children.note: Other expressions yield T& for lvalue, T&& for xvalue, and T for prvalue.

children.label: decltype(auto)
children.note: Forwards return references exactly, though return (local); causes dangling reference UB.

children.label: Structured Bindings
children.note: Introduces a hidden deduced variable with named aliases into array, tuple, or struct fields.

children.label: Hidden Variable Qualifiers
children.note: Qualifiers on auto apply to the hidden whole-object variable, not individual bindings.

children.label: decltype on Bindings
children.note: decltype(binding) yields the member or tuple_element type rather than a reference.

children.label: CTAD & Guides
children.note: Deduces class template arguments from constructors, user guides, aggregates, and aliases.

children.label: User Deduction Guides
children.note: Explicit Pattern -> Template<T> rules override or extend constructor synthesis.

children.label: Copy-Deduction Candidate
children.note: Preferentially deduces std::vector{v1} as copying v1 rather than nesting vectors.
